homeConcepts.prompt:
Design a refined AAA-quality in-game UI concept board for Legend of the Five Rings Emperor Edition, based on the supplied ACTUAL GAME SCREENSHOT and ACTUAL Imperial Favor card scan. The user has rejected previous generic persistent Home trays. New brief: Imperial Favor must be the obvious focal point with a DISTINCT IVORY-WHITE BORDER bearing restrained Japanese noble ornament: karakusa vine engraving, stylized chrysanthemum rosettes, cloud curls, pearl inlay. White lacquer and ivory, tiny aged gold accents, not another gold frame. NO European rococo, kanji labels, generic crown, modern flat UI, or blue-glowing sci-fi. Preserve supplied card face and its real rectangular proportions without rewriting or replacing the card. Every card keeps its complete face. Render beautiful material detail matching the game's aged black lacquer, navy woven mat, warm candlelight and worn brass. The functional Home zone lives ON THE MAT to the player's RIGHT of the provinces, inside the table and left of the right HUD; it is not a new left sidebar, not a battlefield, and must not cover or displace provinces, decks, discard piles or the existing HUD. Favor appears ONLY for its holder; its physical card is a reminder of control, not an ordinary targetable card. Supporting persistent cards such as a Celestial, a Ring and Kata have ordinary restrained thin worn gold edging and remain secondary, at standard card scale. Non-card ongoing reminders such as Suspicions appear as small engraved reminder plaques separate from the physical cards, not card slots. Do NOT include ordinary Events as automatically persistent or include Personalities/Holdings/Regions/Terrain/attachments. No game effects or invented rules text. Concept is static for approval, no implementation. Output one wide landscape design presentation. Layout: the main 75% is a tight oblique gameplay-camera closeup of this right-of-provinces Home grouping, beautifully lit and high detail; small right inset shows the zone's POSITION within the whole existing table using the supplied screenshot, not an entirely redesigned board. Minimal annotation, Caudex serif body and rough-cut all-caps WeatheredQuill-like title. Keep it sparse and practical, not a huge shrine. Label bottom 'Concept · illustrative occupied state'.
D · WHITE LACQUER
A sculpted shallow white-lacquer frame tightly embraces the Imperial Favor card. Thin double ivory border, engraved silver-white karakusa, discrete chrysanthemum corners, small top central pearl medallion. Its card is 120% standard height, lying on the mat and facing same way as player's other cards, slightly elevated only 3mm. Three ordinary persistent cards in a neat 2x2 gold-edged arrangement immediately to its right; Favor on the left of that group is visually dominant. One tiny black reminder plaque 'Suspicions' below supporting cards. No big enclosing panel. This is the most compact and direct option.
homeConcepts.refinement: Make a precise correction to the first reference concept image. KEEP the Imperial Favor white ornamental frame, Favor card, lighting, navy mat, placement and composition exactly as they are. Replace the invented smaller cards with just TWO actual full portrait card faces provided in the SECOND and THIRD reference images: 'Ring of Air' and 'Doji's Guidance'. Render the complete actual supplied scans with their title, art AND complete lower rules-paper areas; do not crop off text, do not repaint new fantasy artwork. These remain normal size, secondary to the large white-framed Favor. Remove the third invented Kata/Way of the Scholar card and leave natural mat space there. On the 'Suspicions' tag REMOVE ALL little circles, coins, pips, empty sockets and counters; it is a slim text reminder only, 'Suspicions' with smaller 'Effect reminder'. No counters or buttons. Preserve the current Favor border design pixel-for-pixel as much as possible. Perform these corrections also in the small context inset. No other redesign. Add discreet title 'D · WHITE LACQUER' outside the game area.
